3.1 Collection Overview

The permanent collection of Kunsthaus Wien comprises 412 works as of 31 December 2023, encompassing oil paintings, works on paper, sculpture, photography, and selected decorative art objects. The collection spans the period from approximately 1875 to 1979, with the highest density of holdings concentrated in the Viennese Secession and its immediate aftermath (1897–1930), the interwar Neue Sachlichkeit movement as it manifested in Central Europe, and the postwar Austrian avant-garde of the 1950s and 1960s.
